title: Feature: a second, faster enemy kind
prompt: Add a second kind of enemy: smaller and twice as fast as the current one. It starts appearing after 20 seconds of play, and there are never more than 2 of them. Draw it in a different colour. In the simulation's State, write how many there are as `fastEnemies`.
notes: A larger rules change that touches spawning, hits, state and drawing. Graded by a hidden scenario on the count over time.

solutionEdits.new:
[[nodiscard]] const std::vector<Float2>& Enemies() const { return _enemies; }
    [[nodiscard]] const std::vector<Float2>& FastEnemies() const { return _fastEnemies; }

solutionEdits.old:
for (auto& enemy : _enemies)
        enemy += Normalized(_player - enemy) * (EnemySpeed * step.seconds);
